long_class_specifier.description_string: Validation model for equipment runtime sorting logic

description.description_string: Convert command signal to real value
Compare to zero to compute equipment status
Signal to inhibit up and down commands
Returns true if equipment is enabled and available

expression.simple_expression:
"

The simulation shows that even wear is achieved among available equipment. When it becomes unavailable, equipment #1 is sent to last position, and automatically moves up in the staging order only if another equipment (#3) becomes unavailable.

We can verify that no equipment gets \"hot swapped\".

"

"
  • March 29, 2024, by Antoine Gautier:
    First implementation.
"
